about: Offline map data for the explorer. Display-only (CONVENTIONS 13.6): nothing here feeds sight reduction, the solver or any accuracy claim. Paths are relative to this file.

sources.name: Natural Earth
sources.licence: Public domain. "No permission is needed to use Natural Earth. Crediting the authors is unnecessary."

conventions.coordinates: GeoJSON [lon, lat], degrees, longitude east-positive (CONVENTIONS section 2), within [-180, 180]
conventions.antimeridian: Polygons are split at +/-180 and meet exactly there; no segment spans more than 180 degrees of longitude; stroke coastline-*.geojson, never the land polygons
conventions.winding: RFC 7946: exterior rings counter-clockwise, holes clockwise
conventions.minzoom: Natural Earth's own suggested zoom, defined for 256-pixel tiles: subtract 1 for MapLibre's 512-pixel tiles

files.use: Land fill. Polygons are split at the antimeridian (RFC 7946); fill only, stroke the coastline file instead.
Coast strokes: the land rings minus their artificial edges along +/-180 and the South Pole, so they align exactly with the land fill.

files.properties: name (null for unnamed), kind (lake | alkaline | reservoir), rank (Natural Earth scalerank, 0 = most important), minzoom (Natural Earth min_label)
files.use: Water fill over land; label large lakes by rank.

files.source: ne_50m_rivers_lake_centerlines (featurecla River; the centre lines drawn through lakes are left out)
files.properties: name, rank (scalerank; width by rank), minzoom (Natural Earth min_zoom)
kind: international | disputed | indefinite | line-of-control (draw the last three dashed)
files.use: Land borders between countries, Natural Earth's default (de facto) view. Maritime borders are not drawn.

files.properties: c (index into gazetteer.json countries), name, iso (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, "" when none), a3
files.use: Point-in-country lookups for the time-zone guess; optional country fills or hover. Borders shared exactly between neighbours; within about 1 km of boundaries-50m.

files.source: ne_50m_admin_1_states_provinces (USA, CAN, RUS, BRA, AUS, IDN, CHN only)
files.properties: r (index into gazetteer.json regions), c (country index), name, code (postal abbreviation, e.g. "PA")
files.use: Point-in-state lookups for the time-zone guess in large multi-zone countries; optional state outlines.
Ice caps and glaciers (Greenland, Antarctica), a white fill. Fill only: polygons meet at +/-180.
Floating ice shelves around Antarctica. Fill only: polygons meet at +/-180.

files.source: ne_50m_geography_marine_polys (label point computed: pole of inaccessibility of the largest part, |lat| <= 78)
files.properties: name, kind (ocean | sea | bay | gulf | strait | channel | sound | reef | river), rank (scalerank), minzoom (Natural Earth min_label)
files.use: Italic water labels for oceans, seas and gulfs.

files.properties: name, kind (cape | island | pole | waterfall | plain), rank (scalerank), minzoom (Natural Earth min_zoom)
files.use: Capes, islands and the poles: landmarks a navigator knows.

files.source: ne_50m_geographic_lines (the date line wrapped into [-180, 180] and split at the antimeridian)
files.use: Reference lines. The tropics and polar circles are Natural Earth's fixed values (23.44 / 66.56 deg); the date line is the civil one, not the 180th meridian.
Search, "near ...", and the time-zone guess (web/src/next/geo). Paths in this manifest are relative to it.
